item.title: Show HN: ChatOSS – A Codex alternative for Open Source AI built on Ollama
item.summary: ChatOSS is built on Ollama. If you use Ollama, ChatOSS local works out of the box. ChatOSS is a GUI desktop app that has multiple agentic coding apps and a kanban board integrated into coding sessions. There's also a simple way to create your own AI powered apps that can run inside of ChatOSS. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49352394 Points: 3 # Comments: 5
